oauth.title: OAuth login to an existing account (with auto refresh)
oauth.description: Log in to your own ChatGPT account in the browser, then paste back the callback URL to get a refresh_token; the backend renews it automatically.

token.description: Supports pasting directly, one per line, or reading from a TXT file, one per line.

session.description: Copy the full JSON from chatgpt.com's session endpoint; accessToken is extracted automatically.

codexAuth.description: Paste the Codex auth JSON; the account source is marked as codex after import.

accountJson.title: Import an account JSON file
accountJson.description: Supports a single-account JSON or a full account array exported by this project, and is also compatible with CPA JSON files.

cpaImport.title: Import from a remote CPA server
cpaImport.description: Go to the settings page to configure the remote CPA server before importing.

sub2apiImport.title: Import from a Sub2API server
sub2apiImport.description: Go to the settings page to configure the Sub2API server, then pick OpenAI accounts from it to import.

token.fromTxtHint: Supports `.txt`; the file content is also one token per line.

session.instructionSuffix: , copy the full JSON returned by the page; `accessToken` inside it is extracted automatically.
session.riskBody: Do not use your main account; prefer a less important one for import to avoid ban risk. This project accepts no liability for any account ban.
session.placeholder: Paste the full JSON, e.g. an object containing "accessToken"...

oauth.step1: (Optional) Enter your ChatGPT account's email; it will be prefilled on the login page.
oauth.step2: Click "Open authorization page" below, then log in to your own ChatGPT account in the new tab.
oauth.step3Prefix: After login the browser jumps to
oauth.step3Suffix: . Copy the full URL from the address bar right away (or open F12, find the callback request in Network, right-click Copy → Copy URL).
oauth.step4: Paste the callback URL into the field below, then click "Finish import".
oauth.pasteCallbackLabel: Paste the callback URL (or just the code)
oauth.noteBody: The authorization code can only be used once. If the browser's callback page finishes loading and shows an OpenAI error page, the code has most likely already been consumed; click "Regenerate" and go through it again. The whole flow just needs to finish within 10 minutes.
